items.title: What Moderna & Merck's cancer vaccine breakthrough means for healthcare stocks
items.summary: Moderna (MRNA) and Merck (MRK) reported promising results in their melanoma vaccine trial, sending the stocks soaring. BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre chat with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about what the breakthrough could mean for Pfizer (PFE) and the larger healthcare sector.

items.title: Yield Hunters Are Swarming This 6.3%-Dividend Stock—And Big-League Hedge Funds are Quietly Buying the Dip
items.summary: Hedge funds are quietly loading up on a battered pharma giant while yield hunters circle its once-near-7% dividend, but with a 14% rally already in the books and patent cliffs looming, the real question is whether the smart money spotted a turning point or a trap.

items.title: This 'Dynamo' Biotech Puts AI-Fueled Breakout In Motion
items.summary: After skyrocketing 1,027% off a low, Relay Therapeutics taps AI and machine learning to fuel more gains.

items.title: BioNTech Stock Surges 22% on Moderna Cancer Vaccine Win. Why the Gains Could Fade.
items.summary: BioNTech, a former pioneer of mRNA cancer vaccines, was part of a broad rally Wednesday. Leerink analysts don’t expect the momentum to last.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock to Research Further and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: Why Is Merck Stock Still Undervalued After An 80% Surge?
items.summary: You do not expect a pharmaceutical giant with a $376 billion market cap to put up numbers that make growth investors blush. Yet over the last 12 months, Merck (MRK) handed investors an 80% return, lapping the S&P 500. The apex occurred yesterday, August 19, 2026, when the stock surged to all-time highs.

items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Faces Fresh Legal Questions, Does It Look Fully Valued?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) is back in focus after a new settlement program was announced for thousands of Depo Provera lawsuits alleging intracranial meningiomas, raising fresh questions about legal overhang and potential financial exposure. See our latest analysis for Pfizer. Pfizer's share price has responded to this mix of legal headlines, product updates and insider buying, with a 1-day share price return of 3.63%, a 30-day share price return of 14.10%, and a 1-year total shareholder return of 19.07%...

items.title: Why Pfizer (PFE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of global pharmaceutical company Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) jumped 3.8% in the afternoon session after positive clinical trial results from peers Merck and Moderna for an mRNA cancer treatment lifted sentiment across the pharmaceutical sector.
